title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Branch-and-Price for Intra-Day Electric Vehicle Charging Scheduling via Partition Coloring
summary: The rapid deployment of electric vehicles (EVs) in public parking facilities and fleet operations raises challenging intra-day charging scheduling problems under tight charger capacity and limited dwell times. We model this problem as a variant of the Partition Coloring Problem (PCP), where each vehicle defines a partition, its candidate charging intervals are vertices, and temporal and resource conflicts are represented as edges in a conflict graph.
